comparators.comparison_axis: minimum reporting of material, biological system, and experimental protocol
comparators.non_equivalence: The R2 field set is a provenance gate; it does not certify that a source has all MIRIBEL fields or that sources are mutually comparable.
comparators.r2_position: Each admitted R2 observation retains source, study, laboratory, material, biological system, protocol, licence, raw asset, worksheet/cell locator and independent-unit lineage.

comparators.comparison_axis: protein-corona prediction using particle, protein, assay, and biological-medium attributes
comparators.non_equivalence: Their training data, targets, preprocessing and validation designs are external and cannot be copied into an R2 score or claimed as an R2 baseline without audited source admission.
comparators.r2_position: These works define nearest methodological comparators for a future compatible corona target and indicate why assay/medium/particle descriptors must be frozen before model fitting.

comparators.comparison_axis: biocorona experimental design, exposure, isolation, and interpretation
comparators.non_equivalence: R2 currently contains no newly generated proteomic corona dataset and cannot make protein-corona composition claims.
comparators.r2_position: R2 treats biological/corona conditions and assay protocol as explicit fields and refuses to collapse different endpoints into one model target.

comparators.comparison_axis: explicit natural distribution shifts and separated in-distribution/OOD evaluation
comparators.non_equivalence: The current T122 sources contain one study per endpoint and therefore do not satisfy this OOD requirement.
comparators.r2_position: T123 requires a fixed compatible endpoint, study/laboratory groups, an external cohort, overlap, effective n, calibration and uncertainty before any OOD report.

comparators.comparison_axis: data, model, code, workflow, and reproducibility disclosure
comparators.non_equivalence: A software replay remains different from independent scientific reproduction or external validation.
comparators.r2_position: R2 provides checksums, source policies, immutable receipts, software-replay artifacts and fail-closed commands.

comparators.comparison_axis: controlled description of nanomaterials, assays, endpoints, units, and provenance
comparators.non_equivalence: The glossary is not asserted to be an eNanoMapper ontology mapping or a complete ontology implementation.
comparators.r2_position: The operating glossary separates material, biology, protocol and outcome; it preserves source-defined units and flags undefined units.

comparators.comparison_axis: results-blind protocol, frozen analyses, and evaluation before results interpretation
comparators.non_equivalence: Pre-registration improves transparency but does not itself produce independent validation.
comparators.r2_position: Paper C remains a protocol with frozen candidate wording until the external evaluator completes T124.

comparators.comparison_axis: claim-to-evidence links, support/refute labels, and rationales
comparators.non_equivalence: Locating a declared spreadsheet cell does not determine whether a scientific claim is supported or refuted.
comparators.r2_position: R2 preserves raw-cell locators, evidence semantics and audit receipts for its source-locator task.
